  html_document: default

```{r setup, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
##parta
#download the data
library(quantmod)
symbol <- "KC=F"
start_date <- "2025-01-01"
end_date <- "2026-01-01"
getSymbols(symbol, src="yahoo", from=start_date, to=end_date)
head(`KC=F`)
tail(`KC=F`)

#extract closing price & clean NAs with linear interpolation
coffee_close <- `KC=F`[, "KC=F.Close"]
coffee_clean <- na.approx(coffee_close)

#plot the data
plot(coffee_clean, main="Daily Closing Price of Coffee Futures (KC=F)", ylab="Price (US Cents/lb)", xlab="Date", col="darkblue", lwd=2)

#ts decomposition
coffee_ts <- ts(as.numeric(coffee_clean), frequency=21)
coffee_decomp <- decompose(coffee_ts, type="additive")
plot(coffee_decomp)

#statistical verification
library(Kendall)
MannKendall(as.numeric(coffee_clean))
months <- format(index(coffee_clean), "%m")
kruskal.test(as.numeric(coffee_clean) ~ months)

##partc
#split the data
train_coffee <- coffee_clean[1:(0.8*length(coffee_clean))]
train_coffee
test_coffee <- coffee_clean[-c(1:(0.8*length(coffee_clean)))]
test_coffee

#add. holt-winters
train_coffee <- ts(as.numeric(train_coffee), frequency = 21)
h_days <- length(test_coffee)
library(forecast)
hw_forecast <- hw(train_coffee, seasonal="additive", h=h_days)
plot(hw_forecast, main="Forecast Using HoltWinters (Coffee Prices)", ylab="Daily Price (US Cents/lb)", xlab="Time", lwd=2)
lines(hw_forecast$fitted, col="red", lwd=2)
legend("topleft", legend = c("Historical data", "Train data (Fitted)", "Test data (Forecast)"), col = c("black", "red", "blue"), lty=1, lwd=2, cex=0.6)

#add. decomp
decomp_forecast <- stlf(train_coffee, h=h_days)
plot(decomp_forecast, main="Forecast Using Decomposition Model (Coffee Prices)", ylab="Daily Price (US Cents/lb)", xlab="Time", lwd=2)
lines(decomp_forecast$fitted, col="red", lwd=2)
legend("topleft", legend = c("Historical data", "Train data (Fitted)", "Test data (Forecast)"), col = c("black", "red", "blue"), lty=1, lwd=2, cex=0.6)

#reg
reg_model <- tslm(train_coffee ~ trend + season)
reg_forecast <- forecast(reg_model, h=h_days)
plot(reg_forecast, main="Forecast Using Regression Model (Coffee Prices)", ylab="Daily Price (US Cents/lb)", xlab="Time", lwd=2)
lines(reg_forecast$fitted, col="red", lwd=2)
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Historical data", "Train data (Fitted)", "Test data (Forecast)"), col = c("black", "red", "blue"), lty=1, lwd=2, cex=0.6)

##partd
accuracy(hw_forecast, test_coffee)
accuracy(decomp_forecast, test_coffee)
accuracy(reg_forecast, test_coffee)

##parte
tsdisplay(coffee_ts, lag.max=50, main="Time Series of Coffee Futures")

#required library
library(tseries)
library(forecast)

#test for stationary
adf.test(coffee_ts)
kpss.test(coffee_ts)

#differencing
ndiffs(coffee_ts)

#test for stationary after applied 1st diff
adf.test(diff(coffee_ts))
kpss.test(diff(coffee_ts))

#test for seasonality
library(seastests)
isSeasonal(coffee_ts)
nsdiffs(coffee_ts, test="ocsb")

##partf
#fi
tsdisplay(coffee_ts, lag.max=50, main="Time Series of Coffee Futures")
tsdisplay(diff(coffee_ts), lag.max=50, main="Time Series of Coffee Futures")
auto.arima(coffee_ts, trace=TRUE)

#fii
arima_coffee_010 <- Arima(coffee_ts, order=c(0,1,0))
arima_coffee_011 <- Arima(coffee_ts, order=c(0,1,1))
summary(arima_coffee_010)
summary(arima_coffee_011)

#fiv
checkresiduals(arima_coffee_010)
checkresiduals(arima_coffee_011)

#fv
library(lmtest)
#coeftest(arima_coffee_010) is not included due to no coefficient to test
coeftest(arima_coffee_011)

#fvi
summary(arima_coffee_010)
summary(arima_coffee_011)

##partg
forecast_30_arima_010 <- forecast(arima_coffee_010, h=30)
plot(forecast_30_arima_010, main="30-Day Forecast of Coffee Futures - ARIMA(0,1,0)", ylab="Daily Price (US Cents/lb)", xlab="Time", lwd=2)
lines(forecast_30_arima_010$fitted, col="red", lwd=2)
legend("bottomleft", legend=c("Historical Data", "Fitted (Learned Past)", "30-Day Forecast"), col=c("black", "red", "blue"), lty=1, lwd=2, cex=0.7)
```
